title: Deep-learning detection of colorectal liver metastasis on CT compared with radiologists
summary: A CNN-based lesion detection algorithm trained on 4,386 CT slices from 502 patients was compared with six readers on a temporally separate validation cohort of 85 patients (99 lesions). Per-lesion sensitivity was 81.82% versus 80.81% for abdominal radiologists and 79.46% for residents, with 1.330 false positives per patient versus 0.357. It is retrospective, single-institution, and generates more false positives than radiologists.
